overview:
**Very High fire danger holds across the Montrose (High Elevation) area today, driven by critically low humidity (15%) and near-record ERC/BI percentiles (93%/96%).**
- Watchout status: 4 of 7 thresholds met (ERC, BI, min RH, max RH) — stay alert to changing conditions.
- Week-ahead trend: danger eases from Very High to High by Monday as light rain and cooler temps arrive late next week.
- Key driver: NNE winds near 12 mph paired with single-digit-to-teens humidity keep afternoon fire spread potential elevated through the weekend.
- No Red Flag Warning or other NWS alerts are posted for this area today.
- Restrictions: Stage 2 fire restrictions were lowered to Stage 1, effective Friday, September 5, for BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands in Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta counties and part of Gunnison County; the GMUG National Forests removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- Nearby incident: the Elk Fire (Gunnison County), lightning-caused, is burning near Lake City, now 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with area, road and trail closures still in effect and structures threatened.
